---
name: architecture
description: Design and document high-level architecture from approved requirements.
---

# Architecture Skill

## Objective

Translate approved requirements into a maintainable technical architecture.

## Procedure

1. Read approved requirements.
2. Inspect the existing application.
3. Identify reusable components.
4. Define proposed components.
5. Define responsibilities.
6. Define interactions and data flow.
7. Identify external integrations.
8. Define security boundaries.
9. Identify failure scenarios.
10. Consider scalability and maintainability.
11. Document technology decisions.
12. Maintain requirements traceability.

## Constraints

Do not implement code.

Do not redesign unrelated parts of the application.

## Approval

Architecture remains PENDING until human approval.
